title: Harry Potter: Chamber of Secrets (GBC) - Hogwarts Dungeon Battle
description:
This is the battle theme for the dungeon in Hogwarts in Harry Potter: Chamber of Secrets for the Game Boy Colour.

It's a surprisingly above-average RPG, and I recommend you check it out.

And yes, I like extremely tiny looped samples.

Original song by Ian Stocker.
